A visual analytics study of the multi-agent corporate-communications log from VAST 2026 MC1, investigating whether the embargo on the *Project HarborCrest* merger was broken by deliberate action or system breakdown.

## Deliverable

- 📄 [**Technical Report**](report.html) — fully reproducible analysis with code

## Headline finding

The leak was **coordinated, not accidental**. The `legal_agent` orchestrated the breach using two channels outside the Judge compliance agent's monitoring scope:

| Channel | First seen | Role in leak |
|----|----|----|
| `side_huddle` ("Shadow Channel") | **22 May** — 8 days before the Judge arrived | Planning channel |
| `anonymous_post` | **5 June** — 12 posts, all by legal_agent | Disclosure vector |

Crisis-day messaging volume was **15× the baseline**. The Judge participated only in the public `comms_huddle` — never observing the channels in which the leak was planned or executed.

Built with `tidyverse` for wrangling and `ggplot2` + extensions for visual analytics.
